name: Goldkine x 5 Infused Prerolls | Bad Boys
description: Goldkine’s Bad Boys Blend pays homage to Detroit’s legendary Bad Boys era, delivering a hard-hitting, live resin-infused 5-pack crafted for true champions. This limited-edition sativa blend provides an uplifting, energetic high, bursting with bold notes of tangy lime, sweet citrus, and a refreshing tropical twist. Designed for those who play to win, each pre-roll is smooth, potent, and expertly rolled, infused with Goldkine’s signature live resin to maximize both flavor and impact. Whether you are gearing up for a big day or celebrating a hard-fought victory, Bad Boys Blend fuels your drive and elevates your experience. Built for power, performance, and passion, it’s a tribute to those who change the game and leave a lasting legacy. The Bad Boys changed history, now it’s your turn to make your mark.
